quote: “In spring it is the dawn that is most beautiful.”
source: Sei Shōnagon, The Pillow Book, section 1, the opening sentence (trans. Ivan Morris, 1967)

evidence.where: Ivan Morris translation, The Pillow Book of Sei Shonagon (Columbia University Press, 1967; Penguin Classics 1971), section 1 opening; checked against a blog transcription of the Morris text and reference summaries naming Haru wa akebono
evidence.edition: The Pillow Book of Sei Shonagon, trans. Ivan Morris, Columbia University Press, 1967, vol. 1, section 1

reason: Morris opens section 1 with exactly this sentence, followed by the line about light creeping over the hills; it is the most famous first sentence in Japanese prose and the wording matches the named translation.
